evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep says 'I'm looking to speak with Natalie' and uses 'Natalie' throughout; customer is Natalie Spruck.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep: 'Specifically, this would take about ten to fifteen minutes of your time. So you can walk away with a quote that you can depend on, is that okay?'
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Rep: 'We talked and we talked to a lot of people everyday and most of them have one or two concerns either the movers are not showing up on time or damage to their items, or either of those a concern for you.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'Yeah, that would be a concern, I don't want anything to be damaged.' Rep reflects back but does not ask 'tell me more about that' or go deeper. Rep immediately pivots to promises. Shallow follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Rep: 'I see. So from what I'm hearing, is that the two common concerns that we have is also a concern for you. And you don't wanted to get your items damaged. Is that right?'
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Rep delivers both: On-Time Guarantee ('If you don't make the agreed upon arrival window, we take $50 off right away for the first hour then $25 more every half hour after that') and No Worries Damage Coverage ('up to $2,000 per month and that's already included on the early rate that you're paying us. No extra cost, no deductibles, no finds.') with permission lead-in: 'before we got into estimating, can I show how we work when it comes to availability and damage protection?'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent close.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Rep gathers: addresses (McKinney Ave to Sperry St), property type (2 apartments, 1-story house), floors (9th floor), walking distance (30 seconds), access concerns, room count, special items (desk, couch, beds). Concern-led opening not explicitly stated but logistics comprehensively covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep asks: 'the typical backs count for two bedroom apartment normally takes 25 to 35 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' and 'do you need help in packing like being the small items into your boxes.' Both asked.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep correctly identifies move size (1800+ sq ft combined) and routes to virtual walkthrough: 'based on your home size, we normally do a virtual walkthrough.' Customer confirms at 4 PM. Rep sends link and confirms receipt. Clean routing to walkthrough_scheduler branch.

top_strength: Rep delivered both promises fully with permission lead-in and personalized the damage coverage explanation by walking through actual protective steps (padding floors, walls, doorways), making the commitment concrete and credible.
coaching_note: At step 2, when the customer raised damage as a concern, the rep should have asked 'tell me more about that' to go two layers deep before pivoting to the promises — one acknowledgment and reflection is not enough to earn full credit on the heaviest item on the card.
